title: Amazon SNS to AWS Lambda
description: Create a Lambda function that subscribes to an SNS topic

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern contains a sample AWS CDK stack to create a Lambda Function, a SNS Topic and the IAM permissions required to run the application. SNS invokes the Lambda function when new messages are available. When messages are sent to the SNS topic, they are delivered as a JSON event payload to the Lambda function.
